Here we want to summarise discussions about the structure of the package, design decisions around functions, and their relationship with the cross-referencing process.

## User journey

- Data preparation
- Validation
- Exploration
- Expert elicitation
  - Within round: Agreement and disagreement
  - Between rounds
- Synthesis and outputs

```{mermaid}
flowchart TB
    PREP["Data Preparation:\nimporting, joining, filtering, modifying datasets "]:::Data
    VALID{"Data\nValidation"}:::InPkg
    EXP[Exploration:\n Interpreters, rounds, membership values]:::InPkg
    NINT{"Nr of interpreters\n and rounds"}:::Data
    ELI[Expert elicitation\nWithin rounds\nagreemnet\nBetween rounds\nEntropy\nFiltering]:::InPkg
    FILTER["Between rounds\nEntropy metrics\nFiltering"]:::InPkg
    SYNT[Synthesis]:::InPkg
    OUTP[Outputs]:::Mixed

    subgraph FIRST["Data preparation and exploration"]
        direction LR
        PREP --> VALID
        VALID -->|no| PREP
        VALID -->|yes| EXP -->|improvements needed| PREP
    end
    FIRST --> SECOND
    subgraph SECOND["Aggregation"]
        direction LR
        NINT -->|"1 interp and round"| THIRD;
        NINT -->|"1 interp and >1 round"| FILTER --> THIRD ;
        NINT -->|>1 interp| ELI --> THIRD;
        subgraph THIRD["Synthesis"]
            direction TB
            SYNT --> OUTP;
        end
    end

    classDef Data fill:#f8f9fa,stroke:#1A1A1A,color:#1A1A1A,stroke-width:2px
    classDef InPkg fill:#dfd,stroke:#040,color:#040,stroke-width:2px
    classDef Mixed fill:#fff,stroke:#853E90,color:#853E90,stroke-width:2px,stroke-dasharray:5 5
```

## Functions, classes and methods  

This package includes functions, classes and methods. Some functionality has been **proposed** and tested outside the package development process. Some of these proposal are integrated in *development branches* before they are implemented in the *main branch*.

We use a consistent key to refer to these in all figures.

```{dot}
//| label: fig-legend
//| fig-cap: "Visual key to functions, classes and methods in different stages of development."
digraph membership {

// classes
node [shape=record fillcolor="#fff4d6", color="#8a5a00", fontcolor="#8a5a00", penwidth=2];
CL[label=<{This is <i>my class</i>|with a description}>]

// methods
node [shape=box fillcolor="#ddffdd", color="#004400", fontcolor="#004400", penwidth=2];
MT[label=<MethodFor(<i>my class</i>)>]

// functions
node [shape=record fillcolor="#e3edfb", color="#1f4e99", fontcolor="#1f4e99", penwidth=2];
FN[label=<{<i>function_name()</i>|with description}>];

node [shape=record fillcolor="#fff4d6", color="#8a5a00", fontcolor="#8a5a00", penwidth=2 style=dashed];
CLWIP[label=<{This is <i>my class</i>|with a description}>]

node [shape=box fillcolor="#ddffdd", color="#004400", fontcolor="#004400", penwidth=2 style=dashed];
MTWIP[label=<MethodFor(<i>my class</i>)>]

node [shape=record fillcolor="#e3edfb", color="#1f4e99", fontcolor="#1f4e99", penwidth=2 style=dashed];
FNWIP[label=<{<i>function_name()</i>|with description}>];

node [shape=record fillcolor="#fff4d6", color="#8a5a00", fontcolor="#8a5a00", penwidth=2 style=dotted];
CLPROP[label=<{This is <i>my class</i>|with a description}>]

node [shape=box fillcolor="#ddffdd", color="#004400", fontcolor="#004400", penwidth=2 style=dotted];
MTPROP[label=<MethodFor(<i>my class</i>)>]

node [shape=record fillcolor="#e3edfb", color="#1f4e99", fontcolor="#1f4e99", penwidth=2 style=dotted];
FNPROP[label=<{<i>function_name()</i>|with description}>];

subgraph cluster_inPkg {
  label = "Main branch"
  FN -> CL -> MT [style=invis]
}
subgraph cluster_WIP {
  label = "Development branches"
  FNWIP -> CLWIP -> MTWIP [style=invis]
}
subgraph cluster_Prop {
  label = "Proposed"
  FNPROP -> CLPROP -> MTPROP [style=invis]
}
CL -> CLWIP -> CLPROP [style=invis]
FN -> FNWIP -> FNPROP[style=invis]
MT -> MTWIP -> MTPROP [style=invis]
}
```

### Core functions

Two core functions create the main classes used in the package. All other functions will work with these two main classes. 

:::{.callout-warning}

Documentation of the classes is missing!

:::

```{dot}
//| label: fig-core
//| fig-cap: "Core functions, classes, methods and their relationships."
digraph membership {

// classes
node [shape=record fillcolor="#fff4d6", color="#8a5a00", fontcolor="#8a5a00", penwidth=2];
MT[label=<{Class <i>membership_tbl</i>|(not documented)}>]
LUT[label=<{Class <i>lookup_tbl</i>|(not documented)}>]

// methods
node [shape=box fillcolor="#ddffdd", color="#004400", fontcolor="#004400", penwidth=2];
LUTP[label=<print(<i>lookup_tbl</i>)>]
MTP[label=<print(<i>membership_tbl</i>)>] 
// 
node [shape=record fillcolor="#e3edfb", color="#1f4e99", fontcolor="#1f4e99", penwidth=2];
LUTF[label=<{<i>lookup_tbl()</i>|Create a lookup table<BR/>for a classification}>];
MTF[label=<{<i>membership_tbl()</i>|Create a membership table}>];

subgraph cluster_prep {
        label="Core functions" style=dashed;
        MT -> MTP [label=<has method>];
        MTF -> MT [label=creates];
        LUTF -> LUT [label=creates];
        LUT -> LUTP [label=<has method>]
    }
}
```

### Validation pipeline

```{dot}
//| label: fig-validation
//| fig-cap: "Validation pipeline: functions, classes, methods and their relationship during a cycle of validation."
digraph membership {

// classes
node [shape=record fillcolor="#fff4d6", color="#8a5a00", fontcolor="#8a5a00", penwidth=2];
MT[label=<{Class <i>membership_tbl</i>|(not documented)}>]
MC[label=<{Class <i>membership_check</i>|(not documented)}>]
LUT[label=<{Class <i>lookup_tbl</i>|(not documented)}>]

// methods
node [shape=box fillcolor="#ddffdd", color="#004400", fontcolor="#004400", penwidth=2];
MCP[label=<print(<i>membership_check</i>)>] 
// 
node [shape=record fillcolor="#e3edfb", color="#1f4e99", fontcolor="#1f4e99", penwidth=2];
ASMT[label=<{<i>as_membership_tbl()</i>|Coerce a data frame<BR/>to membership_tbl}>];
CHECKMT[label=<{<i>check_membership()</i>|Performs checks on a<BR/>membership table}>];
LUTF[label=<{<i>lookup_tbl()</i>|Create a lookup table<BR/>for a classification}>];
MTF[label=<{<i>membership_tbl()</i>|Create a membership table}>];
VMT[label=<{<i>validate_membership()</i>|Validate a membership table}>];

subgraph cluster_prep {
    label="Data validation pipeline"; 
    MT -> CHECKMT [label=input];
    
    LUT -> CHECKMT [label=<input<BR/>(optional)>];
    CHECKMT -> MC -> VMT;
    
    MC -> MCP [label=<has method>]
    VMT -> ASMT;
    ASMT -> MTF;
    subgraph cluster_main {
        label="Core functions" style=dashed;
        MTF -> MT [label=creates];
        LUTF -> LUT [label=creates];
    }
}
}
```
